verdict.rationale: Thoropass has a built-in AI Helpbot (opened with cmd/ctrl+K), but it is documented only as answering questions from approved support and documentation content, not as carrying out tasks. Task-doing AI exists only as single-purpose features: First Pass AI pre-screens evidence and GenAI DDQ autofills questionnaires. The MCP server lets an external assistant act in the workspace, which is not a built-in assistant. Missing for 10: an in-product assistant that takes delegated, multi-step actions in the workspace (e.g. updating evidence requests or controls), plus independent or hands-on corroboration.
